Contributing to tidydiversity

Source: .github/CONTRIBUTING.md

Thank you for helping to improve tidydiversity. Contributions of every size are welcome: bug reports, documentation fixes, examples and new features.

Reporting a problem

Open an issue at https://github.com/jmozez/tidydiversity/issues with a minimal reproducible example, ideally made with the reprex package, and the output of sessionInfo(). Say what you expected and what happened instead.

Proposing a change

  1. For anything beyond a small fix, open an issue first so the approach can be discussed.
  2. Fork the repository and create a branch from main.
  3. Make your change, with tests in tests/testthat/ and documentation in roxygen comments (run devtools::document()).
  4. Check that devtools::check() passes and lintr::lint_package() is clean.
  5. Add a bullet to the top section of NEWS.md.
  6. Open a pull request against main.

Standards

  • Code follows the tidyverse style guide.
  • New statistical methods are tested against a reference implementation or against known true values, and cite the method in their help page.
  • User-facing text uses plain language and British spelling.

Code of conduct

Please note that tidydiversity is released with a Contributor Code of Conduct. By contributing to this project you agree to abide by its terms.
